address: Shop 302, 3F, Alexandra House, 18 Chater Road, Central, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: Ami, decorated on a forest theme, offers a fine dining experience in a casual setting. On top of tasting menus, all-day à la carte choices abound – Gallic staples, dishes to share and bar snacks. The veteran executive chef sources the best produce, pairing it with traditional French sauces. His meticulous craftsmanship reaches its peak in signatures like hand-chopped Wagyu beef tartare, yellow chicken and seafood vol au vent....
